description: This file implements an auto-commit manager for radio objects in a network management system, handling timers and state changes related to radio configuration commits, including initialization, destruction, notifications, and configuration adjustments.

methods.name: void s_startRadioAutoCommit(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Starts the auto-commit timer for a given radio, considering system boot delay and configured delay settings.

methods.name: void wld_autoCommitMgr_notifyRadEdit(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Handles radio FSM change notifications and triggers auto-commit if necessary.

methods.name: void s_autoCommit_th(amxp_timer_t * timer _UNUSED,void * userdata)
methods.description: Timer callback that triggers a commit on the radio.

methods.name: void s_radInit(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Initializes auto-commit timer for a radio.

methods.name: void s_radDestroy(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Destroys auto-commit timer associated with a radio.

methods.name: void wld_autoCommitMgr_notifyVapEdit(T_AccessPoint * pAP)
methods.description: Handles virtual access point FSM change notifications and triggers auto-commit.

methods.name: void wld_autoCommitMgr_notifyEpEdit(T_EndPoint * pEp)
methods.description: Handles endpoint FSM change notifications and triggers auto-commit.

methods.name: void wld_autoCommitMgr_init(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Initializes auto-commit management on radio creation.

methods.name: void wld_autoCommitMgr_destroy(T_Radio * pRad)
methods.description: Cleans up auto-commit resources on radio destruction.

methods.name: void s_initAutoCommit()
methods.description: Initializes auto-commit timers for all radios.

methods.name: void s_cleanAutoCommit()
methods.description: Destroys auto-commit timers for all radios.

methods.name: void s_setEnable_pwf(void * priv _UNUSED,amxd_object_t * object _UNUSED,amxd_param_t * param _UNUSED,const amxc_var_t * const newValue)
methods.description: Sets the enable flag for auto-commit management, initializing or cleaning up accordingly.

methods.name: void s_setDelayTime_pwf(void * priv _UNUSED,amxd_object_t * object _UNUSED,amxd_param_t * param _UNUSED,const amxc_var_t * const newValue)
methods.description: Sets the delay time for auto-commit timers and reinitializes timers if enabled.

methods.name: void s_setBootDelayTime_pwf(void * priv _UNUSED,amxd_object_t * object _UNUSED,amxd_param_t * param _UNUSED,const amxc_var_t * const newValue)
methods.description: Sets the boot delay time for auto-commit system and reinitializes timers if enabled.
